subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core sensitive-state artifact contract now, or keep this draft open until the Scout/Lobster pilot and stress harness prove the operational scope?
rationale: The code issues are mechanical, but automation cannot decide whether this sensitive backup artifact schema belongs in core now or should stay host/plugin-owned until more operational proof exists.

options.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
options.body: Require lockfile and stale-policy cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

options.title: Land Core MVP After Cleanup
options.body: Accept the local-only core command once concrete blockers are fixed and product/security reviewers approve the sensitive artifact boundary.

options.title: Move Host-Specific First
options.body: Defer the core command and keep the behavior in a host/plugin path until a missing OpenClaw core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
recommendation.body: Require lockfile and stale-policy cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.
